about: Hand-curated venue research for the ISRA annual conference, keyed by the code the eventact-agenda adapter gives the conference hotel. Not tied to an edition, because a hotel outlives a programme. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates carry the basis they rest on.

davids-harp-galilee.name: David's Harp Galilee Resort

coordinates.basis: the map pin on the hotel's own contact page

davids-harp-galilee.notes: The conference hotel, above the northwest shore of the Sea of Galilee (the conference site's Home and Accommodation pages name it). The programme runs in three halls, A, B and C, which it does not map onto the hotel's own halls: the hotel lists the Agam hall (475 theatre-style, divisible into Agam A and Agam B, 200 each), four meeting rooms of 15 to 110 and a 700-seat amphitheatre (davidsharphotels.com/galilee/events/), so no seat count is served for a programme hall. Registration, breaks, lunch and the evening social events are listed across all three halls.
